paite: Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
heading: Job Thugen Nihveina
english: Then Job answered,

paite: "Chihtaktak in huchi ahi chih ka thei hi, himahleh Pathian lak ah mihing bangchi in adik thei dia?
english: “Truly I know that it is so, but how can man be just with God?

paite: Amah kiselpih a-utlam ahihleh, sangkhat lak a khatvei zong amah adawng thei kei ding hi.
english: If he is pleased to contend with him, he can’t answer him one time in a thousand.

paite: Amah lungtang in apil a, hatna in thil ahihthei ahi, amah dou in kua akikhauhsak in, alohchingta a oi?
english: God who is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who has hardened himself against him, and prospered?

paite: "Mualte asuan a, athei kei ua, heh a amaute alumleh lai in.
english: He removes the mountains, and they don’t know it, when he overturns them in his anger.

paite: Amun a kipan in lei asing a, huan huai a khuamte aling uhi.
english: He shakes the earth out of its place. Its pillars tremble.

paite: Nisa thu apia a, asuak kei; aksite abilhkhum ngiungiau hi.
english: He commands the sun, and it doesn’t rise, and seals up the stars.

paite: Amah kia'n vante aphalhkhia a, tuipi kihot tung ah apai hi.
english: He alone stretches out the heavens, and treads on the waves of the sea.

paite: Ama'n Zangkhua, Zuheisuktun, Siguk leh simlam aksi munte abawl hi.
english: He makes the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, and the rooms of the south.

paite: Ama'n sui theih vual louh thil thupite sim zoh louh thillamdangte ahih hi.
english: He does great things past finding out; yes, marvelous things without number.

paite: "Ngai in, ka kiang ah apai a, amah ka mu kei, apai lailai a, himahleh amah ka mu kei hi.
english: Behold, he goes by me, and I don’t see him. He passes on also, but I don’t perceive him.

paite: Ngai in, alamang a, amah kua'n akham thei dia? Bang hih na hia? Kua'n akiang ah achi dia?
english: Behold, he snatches away. Who can hinder him? Who will ask him, ‘What are you doing?’

paite: Pathian in ahehna alakik kei ding; Rahab panpih mite amah nuai ah akun petmah uhi.
english: “God will not withdraw his anger. The helpers of Rahab stoop under him.

paite: Bangchi phet a tawmzaw in amah ka dawng in, amah toh ngaihtuah ding in ka thute ka telkhe dia hia?
english: How much less shall I answer him, And choose my words to argue with him?

paite: Diktat himah leng amah ka dawng kei ding hi; ka thukhentu kiang ah thilngetna ka bawl thei lel ding hi.
english: Though I were righteous, yet I wouldn’t answer him. I would make supplication to my judge.

paite: "Amah sam in hon dawng mahleh; ka aw angaikhia chih ka um kei ding hi.
english: If I had called, and he had answered me, yet I wouldn’t believe that he listened to my voice.

paite: Huihpi in ahon kitamsak a, asan om lou in ka liamnate apungsak hi.
english: For he breaks me with a storm, and multiplies my wounds without cause.

paite: Ka nak ahon phal kei a, himahleh thangpaihna in hon dimsak hi.
english: He will not allow me to catch my breath, but fills me with bitterness.

paite: Hatna thu gen leng, ngai in, Amah ahat hi, vaihawmna thu, kua'n hun ahon pe dia?
english: If it is a matter of strength, behold, he is mighty! If of justice, ‘Who,’ says he, ‘will summon me?’

paite: Kidiktatsak leng, ka kam mah in ahon mohpaih hi, hoihkim ka hi, kichi taleng, hoih lou in ahon telsak ding hi.
english: Though I am righteous, my own mouth shall condemn me. Though I am blameless, it shall prove me perverse.

paite: Hoihkim mah leng, ka kilimsak kei; ka hinna ka musit hi.
english: I am blameless. I don’t respect myself. I despise my life.

paite: "Akibang ahi vek a; huaiziak in ke'n hoihkim leh gilou ahihse tuak, ka chi hi.
english: “It is all the same. Therefore I say he destroys the blameless and the wicked.

paite: Jepna in thakhat in thatleh, mihoih thuakna anuihsan ding hi.
english: If the scourge kills suddenly, he will mock at the trial of the innocent.

paite: Lei migilou khut a piak a a-om chiang in huai a vaihawmte amaituam a; amah ahihkeileh, kua ahita dia?
english: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked. He covers the faces of its judges. If not he, then who is it?

paite: Tu in ka nite laihawmmi sang in akinzaw a ataimang ua, hoih amu kei uh.
english: “Now my days are swifter than a runner. They flee away, they see no good,

paite: Long kinte bang in apaimang ua, muvanlai samat tung a ngumkiak bang in.
english: They have passed away as the swift ships, as the eagle that swoops on the prey.

paite: Ka phunna ka mangngilh dia, ka mel lungkham ka pai dia, ka kipak ding, chi leng.
english: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad face, and cheer up;’

paite: "Ka lungkhamna tengteng ka lau a, hoih na hon sa kei ding chih ka thei hi.
english: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that you will not hold me innocent.

paite: Mohpaih in ka om dia; bangziak a athawn a semgim ka hia?
english: I shall be condemned. Why then do I labor in vain?

paite: Vuk tui in kisil in, ka khutte siangsak kei leng;
english: If I wash myself with snow, and cleanse my hands with lye,

paite: Hinapi in phaizang ah na hon pailut dia, keimah puante'n ahon kih ding uhi.
english: yet you will plunge me in the ditch. My own clothes shall abhor me.

paite: "Kei bang in amah lah mihing ahi kei a, amah ka dawn theih a, vaihawmna a ka hohkhawm theihna ding un.
english: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, that we should come together in judgment.

paite: Ka kikal uah kou gel hon mattheihna ding in, thulai genmi a-om kei hi.
english: There is no umpire between us, that might lay his hand on us both.

paite: Kei a pan in achiang lamang henla akihtakhuaina in kei hon lausak kei hen.
english: Let him take his rod away from me. Let his terror not make me afraid;

paite: Huai chiang in thu ka gen dia, amah ka lau kei ding: keimah ah huchibang ka hi ngal kei hi."
english: then I would speak, and not fear him, for I am not so in myself.
